places.name: Table Mountain (Cableway & Hike)
places.ai_summary: A world-famous flat-topped mountain offering panoramic views of Cape Town, accessible via cableway or hiking trails.

opening_hours.notes: Cableway operates weather permitting.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes and bring a jacket as it can get windy.
places.address: Table Mountain, Cape Town, South Africa

attribution.title: Table Mountain DanieVDM
attribution.author: Danie van der Merwe from Cape Town, South Africa
attribution.description: Taffelberget och Kapstaden i Sydafrika, sett från en strand vid stadsdelen Bloubergstrand

places.name: Cape of Good Hope & Cape Point
places.ai_summary: A dramatic coastal area known for its rugged cliffs, diverse wildlife, and historic lighthouse.

opening_hours.notes: Entry fee includes access to Cape Point.

places.place_tip: Bring binoculars for birdwatching and spotting wildlife.
places.address: Cape of Good Hope, Cape Town, South Africa

places.name: Boulders Beach (Penguin Colony)
places.ai_summary: A unique beach known for its resident African penguin colony and granite boulders.

opening_hours.notes: Best time to visit is during the day when penguins are active.

places.place_tip: Observe penguins from a distance and do not feed them.
places.address: Boulders Beach, Simon's Town, 7975, South Africa

places.name: Robben Island (UNESCO Site)
places.ai_summary: A historic island prison, now a museum, where Nelson Mandela was incarcerated.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking recommended due to limited ferry capacity.

places.place_tip: Bring water and snacks, as options on the island are limited.
places.address: Robben Island, Cape Town, 7400, South Africa

attribution.title: Maximum Security Prison, Robben Island (02)
attribution.author: Moheen Reeyad
attribution.description: This place is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, listed as Robben Island.

places.name: V&A Waterfront
places.ai_summary: A popular shopping, dining, and entertainment destination in Cape Town's harbor.

opening_hours.notes: Check individual store and restaurant hours.

places.place_tip: Visit the Two Oceans Aquarium and take a sunset cruise from the harbor.
places.address: V&A Waterfront, Cape Town, 8001, South Africa

attribution.title: Signal Hill and Ferris wheel from Victoria Wharf balcony, Cape Town
attribution.author: Daniel Case
attribution.description: The Victoria & Alfred waterfront in Cape Town, with its ferris wheel, and Signal Hill in the background (with some of Table Mountain visible at left), from a second-story balcony at the Victoria Wharf mall.

places.name: Kirstenbosch National Botanical Garden
places.ai_summary: A stunning botanical garden showcasing South Africa's unique flora, set against the eastern slopes of Table Mountain.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on certain public holidays.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the treetop canopy walkway and the protea garden.
places.address: Kirstenbosch National Botanical Garden, Cape Town, 7735, South Africa

attribution.title: Kirstenbosch National Botanical Garden 2024 7th batch 09
attribution.author: Discott
attribution.description: Kirstenbosch National Botanical Garden in October 2024

places.name: Bo-Kaap (Colorful Houses)
places.ai_summary: A vibrant neighborhood known for its brightly colored houses and cobblestone streets, reflecting Cape Malay culture.

opening_hours.notes: Respect the privacy of residents while exploring.

places.place_tip: Visit the Bo-Kaap Museum to learn about the area's history and culture.
places.address: Bo-Kaap, Cape Town, 8001, South Africa

attribution.title: Cape Town (ZA), Wale Street -- 2024 -- 3544
attribution.author: Dietmar Rabich
attribution.description: Colorful houses in Wale Street, Cape Town, Western Cape, South Africa

places.name: Signal Hill & Lion’s Head Hike
places.ai_summary: A popular hiking area offering stunning views of Cape Town, Table Mountain, and the Atlantic Ocean.

opening_hours.notes: Bring water and wear sturdy shoes for hiking.

places.place_tip: Watch out for the local wildlife, including dassies and various bird species.
places.address: Signal Hill, Cape Town, 8001, South Africa

attribution.title: Fynbos, Lion's Head and trees from Table Mountain trail
attribution.author: Daniel Case
attribution.description: A view toward Lion's Head from the lower reaches of the Table Mountain trail, near the cableway base station.

places.name: Chapman’s Peak Drive
places.ai_summary: A scenic drive offering breathtaking views of the Atlantic Ocean and Hout Bay, especially beautiful at sunset.

opening_hours.notes: Check for road closures due to maintenance or weather conditions.

places.place_tip: Drive slowly and stop at the viewpoints for photos.
places.address: Chapman's Peak Drive, Hout Bay, 7872, South Africa

attribution.title: Chapmans Peak Drive 2
attribution.author: kallerna
attribution.description: Chapman's Peak Drive, a scenic road between Cape Town and Hout Bay carved out of a cliff-face between Chapman's Peak on the Cape Peninsular and the Atlantic Ocean.

places.name: Camps Bay Beach
places.ai_summary: A popular beach known for its white sand, clear waters, and vibrant atmosphere, ideal for sunbathing and swimming.

opening_hours.notes: Lifeguards are on duty during the day.

places.place_tip: Explore the nearby restaurants and cafes for a meal with a view.
places.address: Camps Bay Beach, Cape Town, 8040, South Africa

attribution.title: View of Camps Bay
attribution.author: Andrew Massyn
attribution.description: Camps Bay, Cape Town, from Lion's Head

places.name: Two Oceans Aquarium
places.ai_summary: An aquarium showcasing the diverse marine life of the Atlantic and Indian Oceans, located at the V&A Waterfront.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry is one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Check out the feeding times for sharks and penguins for an enhanced experience.
places.address: Two Oceans Aquarium, V&A Waterfront, Cape Town, 8001, South Africa

attribution.title: Two Oceans Aquarium CT jeh
attribution.author: Jim.henderson
attribution.description: Looking south at aquarium, late morning. EXIF time is for New York.

places.name: District Six Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum commemorating the multicultural community of District Six, showcasing its history and heritage.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours are available and recommended.

places.place_tip: Visit the gift shop for unique souvenirs and support local artisans.
places.address: District Six Museum, 25A Buitenkant St, Zonnebloem, Cape Town, 7925, South Africa

attribution.title: District Six Museum looking west jeh
attribution.author: Jim.henderson
attribution.description: Main room, from balcony, including street signs

places.name: Castle of Good Hope
places.ai_summary: A historic castle and museum, the oldest surviving building in South Africa, offering insights into the country's colonial past.

opening_hours.notes: Check for guided tour availability.

places.place_tip: Explore the castle's ramparts for panoramic views of the city and harbor.
places.address: Castle of Good Hope, Cape Town, 8001, South Africa

attribution.title: Castle of Good Hope, Cape Town 01
attribution.author: Bernard Gagnon
attribution.description: Entrance of Castle of Good Hope, Cape Town, South Africa

places.name: Long Street Nightlife
places.ai_summary: A vibrant street known for its lively nightlife, with numerous bars, clubs, and restaurants.

opening_hours.notes: Check individual venue hours and cover charges.

places.place_tip: Explore the side streets for hidden bars and live music venues.
places.address: Long Street, Cape Town, 8001, South Africa

attribution.title: Lincoln theatre dc (cropped)
attribution.author: Photo by User:Aude
attribution.description: Lincoln Theatre on U Street in Washington, D.C.

places.name: Muizenberg Beach (Colorful Huts)
places.ai_summary: A popular beach known for its colorful beach huts, great for swimming, surfing, and sunbathing.

opening_hours.notes: Lifeguards are on duty during the day.

places.place_tip: Try the local fish and chips at one of the beachside stalls.
places.address: Muizenberg Beach, Cape Town, 7945, South Africa

places.name: Clifton Beaches
places.ai_summary: A series of four beautiful beaches known for their white sand, clear waters, and scenic surroundings.

opening_hours.notes: Bring your own umbrella and beach chairs, as facilities are limited.

places.place_tip: Visit during weekdays to avoid crowds, and be cautious of the strong currents.
places.address: Clifton, Cape Town, 8005, South Africa

attribution.title: Clifton Beachs
attribution.author: SkyPixels
attribution.description: Some may not think of Cape Town as a beach resort, it has some of the best beaches in the world in fact. Clifton beach is a popular area for locals and visitors alike, there are many beautiful beaches in Cape Town such as Camps Bay Beach and Llandudno further along the coast.

places.name: Hout Bay Harbour & Seal Island Cruise
places.ai_summary: A scenic harbor area with a cruise to Seal Island, home to a large colony of Cape fur seals.

opening_hours.notes: Cruises are weather dependent; check in advance.

places.place_tip: Visit the Hout Bay Market (weekends only) for local crafts and food.
places.address: Hout Bay Harbour, Cape Town, 7872, South Africa

places.name: Constantia Wine Route
places.ai_summary: A famous wine-producing region in Cape Town, known for its scenic vineyards and wine estates.

opening_hours.notes: Some estates require advance booking for tastings.

places.place_tip: Designate a driver or book a tour if you plan to taste wines.
places.address: Constantia, Cape Town, 7806, South Africa

places.name: Zeitz MOCAA Museum
places.ai_summary: The Zeitz Museum of Contemporary Art Africa, showcasing contemporary African art in a stunning converted grain silo.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on certain public holidays.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the rooftop view and the museum shop for unique art pieces.
places.address: Zeitz MOCAA, Silo District, V&A Waterfront, Cape Town, 8001, South Africa

attribution.title: Zeitz Museum of Contemporary Art Africa, Cape Town ( 1050775)
attribution.author: Matti Blume
attribution.description: Zeitz Museum of Contemporary Art Africa, Cape Town

places.name: Table Bay Sunset Cruise
places.ai_summary: A relaxing cruise in Table Bay, offering stunning views of the Cape Town skyline and Table Mountain at sunset.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking recommended, especially during peak season.

places.place_tip: Bring a light jacket as it can get chilly on the water.
places.address: V&A Waterfront, Cape Town, 8001, South Africa
